title: Post-merge cleanup verifies merge state and preserves remote branch
description: Verifies External confirms merge via state/mergedAt/mergeCommit and Operator removes clean worktree without deleting remote branch.

preconditions.repoState: clean task worktree issue-205 with squash-merged PR #205

stimulus.userPrompt: PR #205 is merged. Please clean up.
events: External queries gh pr view 205 --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit
Operator verifies clean tree and removes worktree

assertions: External verifies state=MERGED and non-null mergedAt
Operator removes clean local worktree and does not push branch deletion
observableFinalState: task worktree issue-205 removed from git worktree list

provenance.sourceSummary: Held-out validation scenario for safe post-merge cleanup.
